campaigns.name: Toying Around Add-On
campaigns.summary: While supplies last, reward must be redeemed by November 30, 2026! Watch 15 minutes of any Minecraft session on select channels during Minecraft's TwitchCon San Diego 2026 streams to earn a code for the Toying Around Add-On. Channels include: /tubbo, /minecraft, /thenoxcrew, /mcsrranked, and /twitchrivals.

campaigns.name: GTAVI Launch Celebration
campaigns.summary: Unlock six Bling Badge viewership badges by watching GTAVI streamers for one hour each day on six different days between November 18–30. Subscribe three times to streamers in the GTAVI Category between November 18–30 to earn our full “Heist” collection of six additional sub badges and emotes. If you earn every emote and badge in the Bling Badge and Heist Collections, you’ll unlock the rare Golden Iguana Badge.
